name: beifahrer
description: Browser bridge for agents: WebExtension + MCP server. The repository itself holds no state — everything local lives outside it.
//nichts-im-repo: The pairing token is $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/beifahrer/token (outside the repo, regenerable with `beifahrer token --rotate`). The per-site policy lives in each browser profile's extension storage, backed up with that profile.

entries.recreate: gjsify workspace beifahrer-extension build (the bundled build script)
